intro: Clocks fell back and KC woke up thrilled to be on Normal Time, then capped the Sunday afternoon with a Cramer-fueled "we are so back." Extra hour of sleep, extra hour of bangers. ⏰🔥

items.caption: Jim Cramer warns next week "might be even worse" for tech stocks, and KC quote-posts it with pure joy. Inverse-Cramer believers, our captain has spoken. 📉➡️📈
Sunday morning, first day back on Standard Time, and KC is already celebrating with the whole fam. Here's hoping his wish comes true and nobody touches those clocks again. 🕰️✨
items.quote: Back on Normal Time fam, it’s all good in the hood now!  Hopefully that was the last time change ever!!

items.caption: Still on the clock crusade: KC reposted @SaveStandard calling Standard Time the more honest clock, aligned closer to the sun. Consistency is a superpower. ☀️
KC checking in on his buddy @gork like a true friend. Wellness checks for bots, that's the kind of community leadership we stan. 🤖💛
